item.title: Version 0.12.1
item.description: Meetings: the call's echo is no longer written as your words; better Thai-accented English; transcript ready about 1 s after Stop; no You lines while muted. Dictation no longer pastes the old clipboard in slow apps. Small pill on the left, one menu, Google Calendar sign-in.

item.title: Version 0.12.0
item.description: Meetings, rebuilt: separate Dictation and Meetings spaces, more accurate meeting transcripts, one quiet meeting pill, notes shown as a draft that link to the transcript, and copy, export and share. Meetings stays off until you turn it on.

item.title: Version 0.11.3
item.description: - Names from your Dictionary are recognised again: the name helper had stopped working on macOS 27.0.1, and a wrong guess next to a name no longer cancels the right fix. - Newer speech engine (FluidAudio 0.18.3) with repairs for long dictations, plus updated database and update components.

item.title: Version 0.11.2
item.description: - When you fix a misheard word (for example "UX fill" → "UX feel"), Wizper offers to remember that exact phrase and writes it right next time; the word on its own is never changed. - Dictionary phrases keep their capital at the start of a sentence.

item.title: Version 0.11.1
item.description: - A dictation that could not be pasted is now on your clipboard: the box says "Copied — press ⌘V to paste". - Sending a message right after the paste no longer shows "Not inserted". - Typing into remote desktops is faster; less memory used for mixed Korean/Persian + English. - Fewer timing hiccups.

item.title: Version 0.11.0
item.description: Korean dictation keeps the English you say: whole English sentences and English words inside Korean sentences come out in English letters, in the right place, and names keep their capital. Persian with English phrases keeps the English too. Long dictations no longer lose sentences (Retry and Transcribe in History, and long English or Korean dictations on Whisper), and the wait after a long dictation is shorter. Graphite is the default theme (Aurora Glass removed) with a softer logo glow. No Words page: Dictionary is under Model, People under Privacy; review questions and their 464 MB model removed; no scroll bars. Text is typed, not pasted, into remote desktops and VMs, one line in spreadsheet cells, and you see 'Part of it was typed' when typing stops early. Sync never skips a change made while a sync starts, and Dictionary sync is faster for big imports. Small stability fixes.

item.title: Version 0.10.0
item.description: Faster Whisper for long dictations in Korean, Persian and Whisper turbo (text comes about 1–3 s sooner, fewer mistakes). Spoken lists in email and notes. 'I mean' / 'you know' keep a comma before a new clause. Edit rate on Home. Dictionary import and export. A mouse button or a second key can start dictation. Other audio while dictating: Off, Lower or Mute. Cancelled and 'no speech' takes stay in History with Transcribe. wizper:// links for other apps (off by default). Look: 'System' instead of 'Auto'.

item.title: Version 0.9.0
item.description: Simpler Model page with an Auto-detect language switch. One Whisper model instead of two. A simpler Style page (long dashes always avoided). Recordings stop at 10 minutes, with a warning at 9:30. The review asks fewer needless questions. Fixes and cleanups.

item.title: Version 0.8.0
item.description: Smarter grammar fixes in Smart English (an on-device grammar model; never changes your meaning or tense). Practice removed. Meeting notes (off until you turn it on in settings): live transcript, side-by-side summary, Ask, folders, speaker names, auto-stop when the call ends. Many small fixes.

item.title: Version 0.7.0
item.description: Meeting notes: Start meeting from the menu or Home, or from the card that appears when a call starts; a You/Them transcript after Stop. Smart now fixes simple grammar slips. Paragraphs and greeting/sign-off lines in email and document apps. Five start/stop sounds with a volume control. One Smart model and a simpler Model page. Compare: Both right. Background review and Compare work in Low Power Mode.

item.title: Version 0.6.3
item.description: Compare models now runs in Low Power Mode, picks up waiting dictations when power allows, and says when it is paused.

item.title: Version 0.6.2
item.description: Fixes from the last sweep: UK spelling misses caught, commands that look like headlines handled, the faint marks on Home gone, punctuation rules shared by Korean, Persian and German, and many small app fixes.

item.title: Version 0.6.1
item.description: Wizper is now invite-only: a new copy shows Ask for access, and the person who shared Wizper approves it from their own Wizper. Your settings and history are kept. Small fixes.

item.title: Version 0.6.0
item.description: Mute other audio while dictating (General, off by default) and microphone warnings. English spelling: US or UK (Style). Undo right after Wizper types: click the pill. Languages moved to the Model page. Smarter text: "an" before numbers like 18, final periods kept after a correction, more questions get a question mark. Smart-mode model fix downloads only 3 MB. Speech engines updated. Model credits in About. Many fixes.

item.title: Version 0.5.0
item.description: Better Farsi: a speech model trained on Persian (downloads once when Farsi is on). Tidier Model page: models and languages each on one summary row. Fixes.

item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description: New languages: Korean, Farsi and German with automatic language detection (General > Languages). New English model choice: Fast (Parakeet) or Whisper turbo. Model updates. Setup now asks which languages you speak.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description: Polish: clearer Style tones, a working-key warning that says what to do, shorter wording everywhere, a new welcome screen, and 'Open Wizper' in the menu.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description: First version with automatic updates. Your settings are the defaults; 5 more to check on the Words page.
